description:
QR warehouse helps you keep track of your inventory and storage locations.
What can QR Lager do?
• Create and select storage locations using QR codes
• Create and select inventory using QR codes and adjust stock levels
• List overviews of available inventory (across all warehouses and storage locations)
• Document storage and removal either with QR codes or manual entries
What the app cannot do
• Display advertisements
• Display cat videos or pictures
• Pass on your data to third parties
• Place orders on the internet
• Save the world
Thanks to
• Everyone who helped me with bug reports, suggestions and criticism
• The developers of ZXing (QR scanner library
• The teams at IzzySoft and F-Droid for their support with the release
Required permissions
• Access to the camera to scan QR codes
